changelog: Quieter when you are away. The server used to check your inbox twice every fifteen seconds for as long as your coding session stayed open — days, sometimes. Now it checks every fifteen seconds while you are actually using /vibe and backs off to once a minute when you are not; the moment you use a tool it is fast again. Replies still reach a live session within fifteen seconds, and within a minute of an idle one.
features: Inbox checks back off to once a minute when a session is idle, and snap back the moment you use a tool
The rarely used guest-session poll runs once a minute while active and every five minutes while idle
Presence heartbeat unchanged: you stay visible exactly as before
